tickets.title: Initialize schemas and ledger
tickets.done_when: Evidence, thread, forecast, outcome and audit schemas are versioned and tests pass.

tickets.title: Build source registry
tickets.done_when: Pilot regulator Tier B/C endpoints and access methods are recorded.

tickets.title: Discover 150–250 candidate threads
tickets.done_when: Candidate set includes positive and stalled/no-action/altered threads.

tickets.title: Reconstruct RAPID timelines
tickets.done_when: 100–200 usable threads are reconstructed if evidence availability permits.

tickets.title: Build 30–50 GOLD threads
tickets.done_when: Point-in-time versions and leakage risks are strongly verified.

tickets.title: Blind cutoff forecasts
tickets.done_when: Frozen predictions exist for all eligible cutoffs without outcome exposure.

tickets.title: Leakage red-team
tickets.done_when: GOLD and risk-weighted RAPID snapshots have contamination verdicts.

tickets.title: Compute evaluation metrics
tickets.done_when: Calibration, action, timing, content, lead-time and ablation metrics are reproducible.

tickets.title: Independent hard-case adjudication
tickets.budget_rule: Use only on 5–10 disputed/high-impact cases and only if budget remains.

tickets.title: GO/NO-GO report
tickets.done_when: Six core predictive questions are answered and next architecture is justified by evidence.
